subject: Admin activity export options and custody handoff for SIG review
messages:
From: compliance@orchidhealth.com
To: soojin_lee@redwood.example.com
Date: 2028-01-09T09:21:00-08:00
Subject: Request: admin activity exports for SIG assessment

Hi Soojin,

We’re kicking off a SIG assessment next week and need a clear picture of the admin activity evidence we can obtain from Redwood. Specifically the assessor wants:
- Which admin actions are recorded (role changes, API key activity, console sign-ins, privilege elevation, config changes)
- Retention windows per event type and any sampling applied
- Export delivery options (on-demand snapshots, streaming, SFTP, signed manifests) and typical turnaround SLA
- Any PII redaction or recommended scrub step we should expect in delivered bundles

Can you send over a summary and the playbook we’d follow to request a snapshot? Also confirm required contacts and any billing implications for ad-hoc bundles.

Thanks,
Orchid Compliance Team
compliance@orchidhealth.com

From: soojin_lee@redwood.example.com

Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.example.com

Subject: Re: Request: admin activity exports for SIG assessment

Hi Orchid Compliance team — thanks for the heads up. High-level answers below; I’ve attached a short playbook and a sample manifest for the type of export the assessor expects. Happy to jump on a quick call to walk through specifics.

What we log (examples):
- Auth events: console login (SSO), refresh/initial tokens, MFA changes
- Admin API calls: create/update/delete for models, routes, policies, keys
- Privileged operations: RBAC role assignments, service principal creation, deprovisioning
- Configuration changes: network/VPC bindings, audit/export policy changes, retention adjustments
- Operator actions: container restarts, manual cache clears, emergency rollbacks (operator identity is included)

Retention defaults (per policy):
- Auth & privileged ops: 1 year (default enterprise plan)
- Admin API calls & config diffs: 2 years (can be extended via Dedicated contracts)
- Short-lived ephemeral operator debug traces: 90 days (we can snapshot sooner on request)

Export delivery options & formats:
- Snapshot bundle (recommended for SIG): zipped Parquet + CSV manifest + signed HMAC manifest (we include SHA256 checksums). Typical SLA: 48–72 hours for on-demand snapshot; expedited 24h with SOC escalation.
- Streaming export: secure Kafka topic or S3 Put events (near-realtime). Good for continuous monitoring integrations.
- SFTP/S3 drop: encrypted archive (AES-256) with transfer verification; we provide delivery receipts and signed manifest.
- Direct ingestion: we can push to customer SPLUNK/ELK upon mutual auth (requires network allowlist & onboarding).

PII/redaction:
- We redact short-lived tokens and secrets by default. Identifiers like user ids and object ids are included; if you need email/hash-level redaction we support field-level redaction in the snapshot step (add ~24h processing for redaction & verification).

Next steps:
1) Confirm the scope (time range + event types).
2) Decide delivery channel (S3 vs SFTP vs drive link).
3) Provide a recipient public key or SFTP credentials if you want encryption-in-transit to your endpoint.

I attached: sample_admin_activity_manifest.csv and export_playbook_v1.pdf (contains runbook, service contacts, and required attestations). Kim will add technical run commands and SLA notes.

Regards,
Soojin Lee
Senior Compliance PM, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.example.com

From: kimberly_park@redwood.example.com

Date: 2028-01-09T12:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: admin activity exports for SIG assessment

Hi — adding a few technical details and constraints so you can scope the assessor’s ask:

Technical export notes:
- Snapshot generation: we produce partitioned Parquet by day with accompanying CSV manifest. Typical output is ~1–5GB/day depending on activity volume. For high-volume tenants we provide a manifest + incremental deltas.
- Checksums & attestation: every bundle includes a signed manifest (RSA2048 signature) and SHA256 checksums for each file. We can add an HMAC key per-customer on request.
- Retention overrides: customers on Dedicated or Private plans can request retention >2 years; for hosted customers we can schedule recurring exports to satisfy longer-term retention requirements.
- Redaction pipeline: field-level redaction is implemented as a configurable post-processing stage. If you need re-identification controls, provide the exact schema fields to redact.

Operational SLA & handoff:
- Standard on-demand snapshot: 48–72 hours from confirmed scope and delivered creds.
- Expedited: 24 hours + SOC & engineering approval (used for live audits).
- Transfer verification: we upload to your S3 bucket and send a signed manifest; you must confirm checksum receipt for handoff closure.

Run commands (internal):
- generate-snapshot --tenant ORCHID --start 2027-12-01 --end 2027-12-31 --format parquet --redact-file fields_to_redact.txt --manifest sign
- transfer-to-s3 --bucket orchard-audit-receipts --profile orchid-audit --multipart

If you’d like we can pre-stage a sample 7-day bundle to validate redaction & manifest format before the full snapshot. Marcus, can you confirm there are no constraints on providing RSA signatures for this customer?

Kimberly Park
Director, Security Operations
kimberly_park@redwood.example.com
